states.name: route-blog
states.description: Routes a deliverable ticket to its pipeline. Keyed on the entry agent the deliverable catalog assigned at creation, so the board never asks the owner to pick a route.

states.name: blog-draft
states.description: Write the article or product review against the ticket brief.

states.name: blog-review
states.description: Score the draft and post a typed verdict.

states.name: blog-verdict
states.description: The reviewer's typed verdict decides whether the draft ships, is repaired, or escalates.

states.name: blog-seo
states.description: Validate on-page SEO and the publishable frontmatter contract.

states.name: email-approval
states.description: Owner-facing approval. No further pipeline is configured for this deliverable yet.

states.name: social-approval
states.description: Owner-facing approval. No further pipeline is configured for this deliverable yet.

states.name: lead-approval
states.description: Owner-facing approval. No further pipeline is configured for this deliverable yet.

states.name: series-plan
states.description: Plan the multi-part editorial arc. No further pipeline is configured for this deliverable yet.

states.name: published
states.description: The deliverable reached its end state.

states.name: escalated
states.description: The reviewer blocked the draft, or answered with no readable verdict.

states.name: unrouted
states.description: The ticket carries no recognised deliverable entry agent, so no pipeline applies.
